system.description:
This ship is used for surveying, exploration, and as a courier. Can be operated by one crewperson as a pilot and have up to 4 passengers.

Cost: 30Mcr.

J-Drive A (Jump 2); M-Drive A (2G acceleration); Power A; Fuel 40T; Hull 2; CPU Model/1; Staterooms 4; Cargo 3T; Weapon: Double Turret; Crew 1; Hull Type Streamlined; Misc: Air-Raft.

Hull Type: Streamlined allows for atmospheric flight without issue while non-streamlined incurs flight penalties while within an atmosphere. Weapons: see p.76. CPU: see p.78. Drive and power values come from the Engineer Rating By Hull Size table (p.75).

Source: p.69.

Weapon variant: A turret with two barrels is 400Kcr and deals 2 damage.

Turrets are able to fire in a 180 degree area, with a gunner. Otherwise, with no gunner, they are considered fixed mounted.

Weapons require hardpoints in order to be installed. Each ship's hull comes with 1 hardpoint per 100T of hull. Additional hardpoints can be installed, up to x2 the hull’s original hardpoint, at 50,000cr each.

The book gives no range limit or tech level for starship weapons; range is set to long.

A common trader ship for enterprising spacers. It is operated with a crew of 4, including a pilot, engineer, astrogator, and technician. Has up to six passengers and forty low-berth passengers. Two hardpoints allow for two weapons to be installed.

Cost: 40Mcr.

system.crewRoles: Pilot, astrogator, x3 engineers, technician, medic, up to three stewards
system.description:
This ship is designed for passenger or freight transportation for long-range travel. A crew of nine is required: pilot, astrogator, x3 engineers, technician, medic, and up to three stewards as determined by the passenger amount. Up to 21 passengers may be accommodated and 20 low passage units are installed.

Cost: 250Mcr.

J-Drive J (Jump 3); M-Drive D (1G acceleration); Power J; Fuel 210T; Hull 7; CPU Model/3; Staterooms 30; Cargo 129T; Weapon: n/a (3 hardpoints); Crew 8-10; Hull Type Non-Streamlined; Misc: none.

Crew: the stat block gives 8-10 and the text says a crew of nine; crewRequired uses the minimum, 8.

Hull Type: Streamlined allows for atmospheric flight without issue while non-streamlined incurs flight penalties while within an atmosphere. Weapons: see p.76. CPU: see p.78. Drive and power values come from the Engineer Rating By Hull Size table (p.75).

Source: p.69.
